The '''CR70 corvette''' was a predecessor of the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]].<ref name="SWI90">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref> The [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']]<ref name="RebelBpEx" /> was a CR70 corvette before later being retrofitted with the [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite]] to become a CR90 corvette.<ref name="SWI90" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:TantiveIV_CR70.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The ''Sundered Heart'', one of Bail Organa's personal vessels during the Clone Wars]]

The [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite]] was offered to older model [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] like the CR70 in order to bring them in line with the CR90 model.<ref name="SWI90" /> Judging from the use of CR90 corvettes in the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was heavily used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The CR70 Model was a much older design and likely less heavily armed than its future cousin.<ref name="HNN-531-54">''[[Vigilante Taskforce Departs to Engage Separatists]]—[[HoloNet News Vol. 531 54]]''</ref> The Rebel Alliance had several CR70s in usage.

==Behind the scenes==
The CR70 corvette and Vanguard c20 retrofit suite were created as a way to explain the differences between the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] as it appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] as opposed to [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']] and other previous appearances. However, the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} appearance in ''Revenge of the Sith'' was later [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] in the [[2010]] ''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]'' to actually be the ''Sundered Heart''. [[Leland Chee]] confirmed this as a retcon, citing the difficulty of explaining the differences in appearance between the films<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?messageID=17923716#17923653|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2010-08-07|time=2:30 AM}}</ref>
